camping.title: Camping & Accommodation
camping.text: An official camping area is available near the circuit. Pitches are booked separately through the ticketing page. Facilities (toilets, paid showers, 24/7 security) will be provided. Tents and equipment must comply with the event safety rules.

items.q: When and where is the event?
items.a: GP Explorer takes place from October 8 to 10, 2026 at the Bugatti Circuit, Le Mans.
Tickets are available on the Tickets page. Seats are limited — book early.
Yes, official parking areas are available with shuttle services to the venue.

items.q: Is the event accessible for people with reduced mobility?
items.a: Yes — accessible areas and services are provided. Contact us via the Contact page for details.
Please check the event rules for allowed and prohibited items. Safety rules are strictly enforced.
